title: ItemsAdder config.yml
markdownDescription: ItemsAdder main plugin config.yml. Detected by `resource-pack.uuid`.

server.markdownDescription: Server address and port detection settings used for generated resource pack URLs and network-aware plugin features.

uuid.markdownDescription: (default: `d69238f2-b7ce-30b0-8262-17cd9490f29d`) Stable identifier used by ItemsAdder for the generated resource pack configuration.

enabled.markdownDescription: (default: `true`) Enable automatic resource pack application when players join.

before_join.markdownDescription: (default: `true`) Apply the resource pack before the player fully joins, when supported by the server.

delay_ticks.markdownDescription: (default: `1`) Ticks to wait before sending the resource pack prompt.

auto_apply.markdownDescription: Controls whether ItemsAdder automatically sends the resource pack to players.

kick-player-on-decline.markdownDescription: (default: `true`) Kick players that decline the required resource pack.

kick-player-on-fail.markdownDescription: (default: `true`) Kick players when the resource pack download or application fails.

no-host.markdownDescription: Expert mode: ItemsAdder does not host or apply the pack because another plugin, proxy, or server handles it. [Docs](https://itemsadder.devs.beer/plugin-usage/plugin-configuration/resourcepack-hosting/no-host)

server_address.markdownDescription: (default: `auto`) Optional address and port for simple self host. `auto` lets ItemsAdder decide it automatically.

block_non_game_requests.markdownDescription: (default: `true`) Block requests that do not look like Minecraft client resource pack downloads.

max_downloads_per_ip.markdownDescription: (default: `5`) Maximum number of downloads allowed from the same IP during the configured window.

max_speed_in_megabyte_ps.markdownDescription: (default: `30`) Maximum resource pack download speed per connection, in megabytes per second.

optimization.markdownDescription: Download protection and throttling options for simple self host.

simple_self_host.markdownDescription: Plug-and-play hosting introduced for ItemsAdder 4.0.17+. It does not require manual port forwarding; generate the pack with `/iazip`. [Docs](https://itemsadder.devs.beer/plugin-usage/plugin-configuration/resourcepack-hosting)

lobfile.markdownDescription: Automatically uploads the pack to LobFile. This avoids exposing the server IP and reduces server bandwidth usage. [Docs](https://itemsadder.devs.beer/plugin-usage/plugin-configuration/resourcepack-hosting/lobfile)

url.markdownDescription: (default: `""`) Direct downloadable URL of the generated resource pack zip. Reload ItemsAdder after changing it.

skip_url_file_type_check.markdownDescription: (default: `false`) Skip ItemsAdder URL file type checks. Use only when your external host cannot expose a normal zip URL.

external-host.markdownDescription: Use an externally hosted resource pack URL, such as Google Drive, Dropbox, OneDrive, CDN, or custom hosting. [Docs](https://itemsadder.devs.beer/plugin-usage/plugin-configuration/resourcepack-hosting/google-drive)

server-ip.markdownDescription: (default: `127.0.0.1`) Public address used by players to download the pack. Use the server IP, or a proxied pack domain when configured.

pack-port.markdownDescription: (default: `8163`) Dedicated resource pack hosting port. This is not the Minecraft server port.

append-port.markdownDescription: (default: `true`) Append `pack-port` to the generated pack URL. Disable it when a proxy or domain rule already maps the port.

cooldown.markdownDescription: Cooldown, in seconds, before the same address can retry after hitting the self-host rate limit.

rate_limit.markdownDescription: Rate limit protection for the self-hosted resource pack endpoint.

protection.markdownDescription: Protection and rate limit settings for the self-hosted pack endpoint.

self-host.markdownDescription: Host the pack directly from the Minecraft server. Useful while developing because `/iazip` updates the hosted pack immediately. [Docs](https://itemsadder.devs.beer/plugin-usage/plugin-configuration/resourcepack-hosting/self-hosting)

hosting.markdownDescription: Choose exactly one resource pack hosting method. Official docs recommend LobFile, simple self host, or self-host depending on the setup. [Docs](https://itemsadder.devs.beer/plugin-usage/plugin-configuration/resourcepack-hosting)

title.markdownDescription: Title shown in the Minecraft resource pack prompt when ItemsAdder sends the pack to players.

notify_other_plugins_resourcepacks.markdownDescription: (default: `true`) Notifies if other plugins are sending a resource pack to players. This is useful for debugging and compatibility.

protect-player.markdownDescription: Prevents or limits player actions while the required resource pack is being applied.

command.markdownDescription: Settings for the resource pack command and its cooldown behavior.

custom-font.markdownDescription: Custom font settings used by ItemsAdder generated resource pack text rendering.

thin-font.markdownDescription: Thin font generation settings for the ItemsAdder resource pack.

protect-file-from-unzip.markdownDescription: Adds zip protection markers to discourage manual extraction of the generated resource pack.

compress-png-files.markdownDescription: (default: `true`) Compresses PNG files in the generated resource pack zip using `pngquant`.

compress-json-files.markdownDescription: (default: `true`) Compress JSON files in the generated resource pack zip using `json-minify`.

compress-shader-files.markdownDescription: (default: `true`) Compress shader files in the generated resource pack zip using `glsl-minify`.

enabled.markdownDescription: (default: `true`) Compresses sound files in the generated resource pack zip using `ffmpeg`.

bitrate_quality.markdownDescription: (default: `100`) Bitrate quality for sound compression. Higher values preserve more audio quality but result in larger file sizes.

compress_sounds.markdownDescription: Audio compression settings used while generating the resource pack zip.

overwrite_leather_layers.markdownDescription: (default: `true`) Overwrites vanilla leather armor layers with custom ones.

1_21_4_lower.markdownDescription: (default: `true`) Enables legacy shader generation for Minecraft versions 1.21.4 and lower.

1_21_5_plus.markdownDescription: (default: `true`) Enables shader generation for Minecraft versions 1.21.5 and higher.

generate_shader.markdownDescription: Minecraft-version-specific switches for generating legacy vanilla armor shader files.

vanilla.markdownDescription: Legacy custom armor shader generation for vanilla clients.

generate_cit.markdownDescription: Minecraft-version-specific switches for generating OptiFine CIT files for custom armor.

optifine.markdownDescription: OptiFine CIT compatibility generation for legacy custom armor resource packs. [Issue context](https://github.com/PluginBugs/Issues-ItemsAdder/issues/4004)

custom_armors_shaders_legacy.markdownDescription: Legacy custom armor shader and CIT generation options for older clients and compatibility packs.

legacy_shaders.markdownDescription: (default: `false`) Enables legacy shader generation for ItemsAdder emotes. This is only needed for Minecraft versions 1.21.4 and lower.

1_21_5_to_1_21_9_shaders.markdownDescription: (default: `false`) Enables shader generation for ItemsAdder emotes for Minecraft versions 1.21.5 to 1.21.9.

1_21_4_plus_modern_method.markdownDescription: (default: `true`) Enables the modern shader generation method for ItemsAdder emotes for Minecraft versions 1.21.4 and higher.

emotes.markdownDescription: Resource pack shader and model compatibility options for ItemsAdder emotes.

fix_dark_in_inventory.markdownDescription: (default: `true`) Fixes the issue where items appear dark in the inventory.

fix_missing_particle.markdownDescription: (default: `true`) Fixes the issue where particles are missing from custom items.

enabled.markdownDescription: (default: `true`) Enables the fix for Minecraft 1.21.11+ item models.

models.markdownDescription: Model names affected by the Minecraft 1.21.11+ item atlas compatibility fix.

fix_1_21_11_plus_atlas_items_models.markdownDescription: Fixes Minecraft 1.21.11+ item model atlas issues when merged models use item textures. [Issue context](https://github.com/PluginBugs/Issues-ItemsAdder/issues/5282)

models.markdownDescription: Model generation fixes applied while building the resource pack zip.

ignore-files-ext.markdownDescription: File extensions ignored when ItemsAdder builds the generated resource pack zip.

contents-folders-priority.markdownDescription: Content folder priority order used when multiple packs define the same generated resource pack asset.

merge_other_plugins_resourcepacks_folder.markdownDescription: Merge resource pack folders provided by other plugins into the generated ItemsAdder pack.

zip.markdownDescription: Options used while generating the resource pack zip with `/iazip`.

CustomModelData-starting-value.markdownDescription: Starting CustomModelData values per material, or `ALL`, used for generated item models.

items.markdownDescription: Generated item model settings for ItemsAdder custom items.

custom_blocks_sounds_patch.markdownDescription: Patches generated resource pack sound data so custom blocks can use step, break, place, and related sounds.

pre_1_21_2_shaders_fix.markdownDescription: Compatibility shader fix for clients older than Minecraft 1.21.2.

resource-pack.markdownDescription: Resource pack download, hosting, protection, prompt, font and zip generation settings.

lang.markdownDescription: (default: `en`) Language file name used for ItemsAdder commands, messages, and GUIs.

dictionaries-lang.markdownDescription: (default: `en`) Dictionary language used by ItemsAdder legacy dictionaries for item names, lore, and menu categories.

config_files.markdownDescription: Language and config loading options. `lang` controls plugin messages, while `dictionaries-lang` controls ItemsAdder dictionary text. [Docs](https://itemsadder.devs.beer/plugin-usage/plugin-configuration/languages)

note.markdownDescription: (default: `true`) Enables ItemsAdder custom block features for note blocks.

mushroom.markdownDescription: (default: `true`) Enables ItemsAdder custom block features for mushroom blocks.

chorus.markdownDescription: (default: `true`) Enables ItemsAdder custom block features for chorus blocks.

wire.markdownDescription: (default: `false`) Enables ItemsAdder custom block features for wire blocks.

fire.markdownDescription: (default: `false`) Enables ItemsAdder custom block features for fire blocks.

custom.markdownDescription: Feature toggles for ItemsAdder custom block implementations and their backing vanilla block types.

worlds.markdownDescription: World allow or deny patterns where ItemsAdder custom block features are active.

enabled.markdownDescription: (default: `true`) Cancel custom block breaking when the player uses a wrong tool.

send-actionbar.markdownDescription: (default: `true`) Send an action bar message to the player when they try to break a custom block with a wrong tool.

cancel-break-wrong-tool.markdownDescription: Cancels custom block breaking when the player uses a wrong tool and optionally shows feedback.

fix-liquids-flow.markdownDescription: (default: `true`) Fix liquid flow interactions around custom blocks.

fix-floating-blocks.markdownDescription: (default: `true`) Fix unsupported floating custom blocks after nearby block updates.

enabled.markdownDescription: (default: `true`) Repair glitched custom blocks in chunks.

only-new-chunks.markdownDescription: (default: `false`) Only repair glitched blocks in newly generated chunks.

fix-glitched-blocks.markdownDescription: Repair glitched custom blocks in chunks. Do not enable together with vanilla block conversion.

enabled.markdownDescription: (default: `false`) Convert matching vanilla blocks into ItemsAdder custom blocks.

only-new-chunks.markdownDescription: (default: `true`) Only convert vanilla blocks in newly generated chunks.

convert-vanilla-blocks.markdownDescription: Convert matching vanilla blocks into ItemsAdder custom blocks. Do not enable together with glitched block fixing.

blocks.markdownDescription: Global custom block conversion, placement, liquid, palette and compatibility settings.

fix-show-attack-and-damage-as-lore.markdownDescription: (default: `true`) Shows attack and damage values as lore for ItemsAdder custom items.

hide-custom-durability-lore.markdownDescription: (default: `true`) Hides custom durability lore for ItemsAdder custom items.

itemsadder_trade_machines.markdownDescription: (default: `true`) Makes ItemsAdder items work in trade machines even when renamed or modified.

other_plugins.markdownDescription: (default: `true`) Makes ItemsAdder items work in trade machines from other plugins even when renamed or modified.

fix_trades_guis_match_custom_items.markdownDescription: Makes trade and GUI item matching aware of ItemsAdder custom item metadata.

enabled.markdownDescription: (default: `true`) Kicks players who spam quickbar or hotbar item interactions above the configured threshold.

ms.markdownDescription: (default: `200`) Time window in milliseconds to count quickbar or hotbar item interactions.

clicks.markdownDescription: (default: `6`) Maximum number of interactions allowed within the time window.

kick_on_quickbar_spam.markdownDescription: Kicks players who spam quickbar or hotbar item interactions above the configured threshold.

optimizations.markdownDescription: Performance and anti-spam settings for custom item interactions.

enabled.markdownDescription: (default: `true`) Enable automatic updating of old ItemsAdder versions item metadata to the current format.

update_durability.markdownDescription: (default: `true`) Updates the durability of old ItemsAdder items to the current format.

update-legacy-items.markdownDescription: Updates old ItemsAdder item metadata to the current format when items are detected.

enabled.markdownDescription: (default: `true`) Enable automatic updating for every custom item unless disabled in that item configuration.

fix_unstackable_items_on_click.markdownDescription: (default: `true`) Force merge clicked custom items that share the same namespace and id even when display data differs.

auto_update.markdownDescription: Globally controls automatic updates for custom items already present in inventories or the world. [Docs](https://itemsadder.devs.beer/plugin-usage/plugin-configuration/items-updater)

items.markdownDescription: Global item behavior settings, including updater and legacy item conversion options.

liquids.markdownDescription: Global feature toggle for ItemsAdder custom liquids.

enabled.markdownDescription: (default: `false`) Forces a global text color for ItemsAdder HUD rendering.

color.markdownDescription: (default: `#FFFFFF`) Hex color code used for forced global text color in ItemsAdder HUD rendering.

force_color.markdownDescription: Forces a global text color for ItemsAdder HUD rendering.

huds.markdownDescription: Global HUD feature settings. HUDs can also display ItemsAdder custom player stats.

refresh_ticks.markdownDescription: (default: `1`) The number of ticks between cooldown bar updates.

bossbar.markdownDescription: BossBar renderer settings for ItemsAdder cooldown bars.

loots.markdownDescription: Global loot behavior settings for ItemsAdder custom drops.

worldguard.markdownDescription: WorldGuard compatibility settings for ItemsAdder regions, flags, furniture, and custom interactions.

advanced_enchantments.markdownDescription: AdvancedEnchantments compatibility for enchantments used by ItemsAdder custom items.

compatibility.markdownDescription: Compatibility toggles for external plugins and legacy integrations.

chat.markdownDescription: Controls font image replacement and suggestions in chat.

excluded.markdownDescription: Commands where ItemsAdder font image replacement is disabled.

command.markdownDescription: Controls font image replacement in commands and command blocks.

customitem_name_and_lore.markdownDescription: Controls font image replacement in custom item names and lore.

sign.markdownDescription: Controls font image replacement on signs.

book.markdownDescription: Controls font image replacement in books.

anvil.markdownDescription: Controls font image replacement in anvil rename text.

inventory-title.markdownDescription: Controls font image replacement in inventory titles.

scoreboard-teams.markdownDescription: Font image replacement settings for scoreboard team prefixes and suffixes.

font_images.markdownDescription: Global support settings for ItemsAdder font images, glyphs, emojis, GUI glyphs and related placeholders. [Docs](https://itemsadder.devs.beer/adding-content/font-images)

chat.markdownDescription: Enables ItemsAdder text effects in chat messages. [Docs](https://itemsadder.devs.beer/plugin-usage/plugin-configuration/text-effects-1.17+)

customitem_name_and_lore.markdownDescription: Enables ItemsAdder text effects in custom item names and lore.

sign.markdownDescription: Enables ItemsAdder text effects on signs.

book.markdownDescription: Enables ItemsAdder text effects in books.

anvil.markdownDescription: Enables ItemsAdder text effects in anvil rename text.

text_effects.markdownDescription: Special animated and coloring text effects. Requires Minecraft 1.17+ clients and resource pack regeneration with `/iazip`. [Docs](https://itemsadder.devs.beer/plugin-usage/plugin-configuration/text-effects-1.17+)

max-furniture-vehicles-per-chunk.markdownDescription: (default: `30`) Maximum furniture vehicles allowed in one chunk.

max_furniture_per_chunk.markdownDescription: (default: `20`) Maximum furniture entities allowed in one chunk.

expert_users.markdownDescription: Advanced custom entity packet and performance options. Change only when you understand the impact.

custom_entities.markdownDescription: Global settings for ItemsAdder custom entities.

furniture.markdownDescription: Global settings for ItemsAdder furniture entities and furniture placement behavior.

entities.markdownDescription: Global limits and compatibility options for ItemsAdder custom entities, furniture and vehicles. [Docs](https://itemsadder.devs.beer/adding-content/entities)

avg_seconds_per_stage.markdownDescription: (default: `240`) Default average seconds for a crop to grow by one stage under optimal conditions.

max_crops_in_area.markdownDescription: (default: `1000`) Maximum custom crops allowed in the configured area to limit performance cost.

area_limit_blocks_radius.markdownDescription: (default: `32`) Radius used by the crop area limit.

billboard.markdownDescription: Billboard rendering uses simpler far-away crop models for better client performance.

checkerboard_pattern.markdownDescription: Checkerboard rendering options for custom crops, used to reduce visual repetition and improve crop visibility.

rendering.markdownDescription: Performance-related rendering options for custom crops.

crops.markdownDescription: Global defaults for custom crop growth and rendering. Custom crops require ItemsAdder 4.0.15+ and Minecraft 1.21.4+. [Docs](https://itemsadder.devs.beer/adding-content/crops)

crafting.markdownDescription: Enable or disable ItemsAdder crafting table recipes.

cooking.markdownDescription: Enable or disable ItemsAdder furnace, smoker, campfire and blasting recipes.

anvil.markdownDescription: Enable or disable ItemsAdder anvil recipes.

smithing.markdownDescription: Enable or disable ItemsAdder smithing recipes.

unlock.markdownDescription: Controls when ItemsAdder custom recipes are unlocked for players.

custom-recipes.markdownDescription: Controls registration and unlock behavior for ItemsAdder custom recipes. [Docs](https://itemsadder.devs.beer/adding-content/recipes)

list.markdownDescription: Vanilla materials or recipe keys to remove from the server recipe registry.

remove-vanilla-recipes.markdownDescription: Remove selected vanilla recipes from the server.

recipes.markdownDescription: Global recipe system settings for crafting, cooking, anvil, smithing, recipe book unlocks and vanilla recipe removal. [Docs](https://itemsadder.devs.beer/adding-content/recipes)

save_type.markdownDescription: (default: `CUSTOM_NBT`) `CUSTOM_NBT` stores stats in ItemsAdder storage; `PLAYER_DAT` stores them in the vanilla player.dat file.

player_stats.markdownDescription: Custom player stats added by ItemsAdder. They can be read by commands, PlaceholderAPI, and HUDs. [Docs](https://itemsadder.devs.beer/other/custom-player-stats)

append_new_equipment_tag.markdownDescription: Appends the new equipment tag while keeping legacy armor shader data.

completely_convert_to_new_equipment_tag.markdownDescription: Fully converts legacy shader armor data to the new equipment tag format.

legacy_shader_armor_conversion.markdownDescription: Migration options for converting legacy shader armor data to newer equipment-based formats.

ffmpeg.markdownDescription: FFmpeg integration settings used by ItemsAdder for media conversion tasks such as audio processing.

auto_re_join.markdownDescription: Automatically reconnects players when registry changes require a clean client-server state.

kick.markdownDescription: Kicks players when registry changes require manual reconnection.

on_registries_changes.markdownDescription: Actions to run when Minecraft registries change and clients may need to refresh server state.

advanced.markdownDescription: Advanced ItemsAdder behavior and migration settings. Change only when needed for compatibility or debugging.

compression.markdownDescription: Debug logging for resource pack compression operations.

resourcepacks.markdownDescription: Debug logging for resource pack generation, compression, overlays, and player installation.

items.markdownDescription: Debug logging for custom item loading, reloading, warnings, loots, HUDs, armors, and related systems.

recipes.markdownDescription: Debug logging for custom recipe loading, disabled recipes, vanilla recipe removal, and packet-size fixes.

log-save-load.markdownDescription: Logs custom block save/load operations, optionally only when they exceed a minimum duration.

blocks.markdownDescription: Debug logging for custom block conversion, saving, loading, and unusual break handling.

blocks-populators.markdownDescription: Debug logging for block populators while loading or skipping world generation rules.

trees-populators.markdownDescription: Debug logging for custom tree populators.

surface-decorators.markdownDescription: Debug logging for surface decorator generation.

cave-decorators.markdownDescription: Debug logging for cave decorator generation.

player-stats.markdownDescription: Debug logging for custom player stat loading, saving, and updates.

performance.markdownDescription: Debug logging for performance-sensitive ItemsAdder operations.

huds.markdownDescription: Debug logging for HUD loading and rendering behavior.

other.markdownDescription: Miscellaneous debug logging for ItemsAdder systems not covered by more specific sections.

categories.markdownDescription: Debug logging for category and GUI category loading.

entities.markdownDescription: Debug logging for custom entities, furniture, and related entity systems.

issues.markdownDescription: Extra diagnostics useful when reporting ItemsAdder issues.

scripts.markdownDescription: Debug logging for ItemsAdder script loading and execution.

debug.markdownDescription: Debug logging settings for ItemsAdder systems. Enable only while diagnosing issues.
